description: C# is a language for making programs such as apps and games. It uses the .NET tool kit. Begin with simple messages and numbers, then learn choices, loops, lists and objects. Each example gives you a small change to try. Follow the setup lesson to run the programs on your computer. The site itself does not need a C# server.
versionNote: Targets .NET 10 (LTS, November 2025) at the C# 13 language level; every example also compiles with the C# 14 compiler bundled in the .NET 10 SDK.
whatYouWillLearn: Run a short C# program with .NET
Work with names, numbers and choices
Store groups of values and write methods
Read files and check results with tests
learningObjectives: Print a greeting and add two numbers
Use if to check a score

seo.title: C# Tutorial: Learn with Small Steps
seo.description: Learn C# with simple examples of values, conditions, loops, lists and classes. Build your skills one lesson at a time and check them with a quiz.
